title: Florida sinks 1,500 tons of concrete off Destin to create 3 reefs
description: Workers are currently deploying three million pounds of recycled concrete drainage pipes to create artificial reefs on the seabed. This innovative project intends to boost marine habitats for local fish species, enhancing both fishing and diving experiences. Positioned between four and eight nautical miles off East Pass, the varied depths of the sites will facilitate diverse marine life.

title: Howrah woman becomes bus conductor to fulfill late father's dream

Amidst the pandemic and increasing competition, she embraced the role of conductor, showcasing her tenacity. With support from local transport authorities, she obtained a new route permit, driving her business forward. Her journey truly embodies resilience and the honoring of a cherished promise.

description: In an inspiring project, eighth-grader Locklyn Raye Ward from Oklahoma explored the antibacterial capabilities of wild plants. Analyzing 24 plants sourced from her family’s farm, she found that 56 percent demonstrated antibacterial effects, but none were as potent as commercial antibiotics. Interestingly, seven native plants showcased promising antibiotic properties, prompting Locklyn to highlight the importance of wild plants while addressing the significant issue of antibiotic overuse.

Students can work off campus for a maximum of 24 hours per week during study sessions. Violating these work conditions can lead to serious repercussions, including loss of student status. Furthermore, unauthorized work may result in a permanent record of fraud with IRCC and a five-year return ban.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy emphasized the urgency of immediate deliveries to address winter threats. The planned delivery timelines have raised concerns regarding the effectiveness of Ukraine's defense capabilities. Zelenskyy has requested a winter support package involving immediate supplies from existing stocks.

description: The national capital region will implement a complete ban on construction and demolition activities from November 5 to 20. This measure is part of a broader initiative to combat rising winter pollution levels. Union environment minister Bhupender Yadav confirmed that there would be no rollback of existing vehicle entry restrictions. Additionally, swift actions will target non-conforming industries and pollution hotspots in the region.

She set out to build what was missing, creating an academy, tournaments, and communities for players across ages and abilities. Today, her initiatives span eight states, championing accessibility, inclusion and a culture where chess thrives beyond ratings, titles and competition.

Firefighters responded quickly and managed to rescue six people trapped inside the building. Two injured victims were taken to Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital for treatment following the incident. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation by local authorities and police personnel.

New Zealand set an impressive target of 259 runs, winning the match by 87 runs and narrowing India’s series lead to 3-1. Glenn Phillips played a vital role with his half-century, while India struggled to reach just 172 runs in response.

She also discusses women's cricket's growth and her plans to mentor young cricketers.

description: GSLV-F18 carrying 2,250kg next-generation navigation satellite -- NVS-03 -- lifted off from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR) in Sriharikota at 11.51pm on Friday, as scheduled. Around 18 minutes later, NVS-03 satellite was placed in a geosynchronous transfer orbit (GTO) of 37,023km apogee and 170km perigee.

title: Ajay Devgn moves Bombay HC over FDA’s pan masala ad notice
description: Ajay Devgn has initiated legal proceedings in the Bombay High Court over show-cause notices related to advertisements for pan masala. Shah Rukh Khan and Tiger Shroff are also under scrutiny, facing similar notices. The actors must withdraw their ads and explain their endorsement agreements, considering that Vimal Pan Masala is deemed a prohibited smokeless tobacco product in the region.

title: Tanker with 27 Indian seafarers targeted in first-ever limpet mine attack in Hormuz
description: On October 29 and 30, two oil tankers were targeted in separate attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. MT LOUISE 1 was struck by limpet mines that caused a fire in its engine room. The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil export routes, connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea. It has faced repeated security incidents since the conflict between US and Iran began.

title: Father's death, a promise and Worlds gold: Manisha Bhanwala's story
description: Manisha Bhanwala defeated American Abigail Nette 8-6 in a thrilling comeback victory in the final to become the first Indian woman wrestler to win a World Championships gold. But behind this historic achievement was a personal story of loss, family sacrifices and a promise she had made to herself.

title: Cargo ship stranded in Pakistan for months, sailor's kin high & dry
description: Vedansh Mishra, a three-year-old, frequently asks about his father, Vineet, who is stranded in Karachi, Pakistan. Vineet has been unable to leave the cargo ship since April, with his family seeking help from politicians. Despite appeals to government officials, the family has yet to achieve a resolution in bringing him home. Communication with Vineet is limited due to poor network connectivity and ongoing ship conditions.

title: Melinda French Gates says her 2-day rule helps employees know they did a good job
description: Melinda French Gates implements a 48-hour feedback rule for employees to manage work conflicts effectively. This approach allows employees to feel secure in their performance evaluations as surprises are avoided. She emphasizes the importance of giving honest feedback with integrity while maintaining respect. Recently, Gates pledged $215 million to improve women's health and called for better accountability in healthcare systems.
